تكحون (form I)
# تَكُحُّونَ (takuḥḥūna) /ta.kuħ.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of كَحَّ (kaḥḥa)
# تُكَحُّونَ (tukaḥḥūna) /tu.kaħ.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of كَحَّ (kaḥḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
